content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Panchayat Korba Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://korba.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by District Panchayat Korba (Chhattisgarh) to fill various contractual vacancies in the region.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in District Panchayat Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Computer Programmer and Program Officer, with a total of 3 vacancies announced under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 23-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download the form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates is between 21 years and 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per Chhattisgarh government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Computer Programmer?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with PGDCA, B.Sc (Computer Science/IT) or equivalent, along with proficiency in .NET, Java, MS SQL, or Oracle.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for the Program Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Program Officer position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 39,875.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates as the fee is listed as Nil for all categories.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the preparation of a merit list based on candidates' qualifications and experience, followed by a skill test.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website at https://korba.gov.in or through the links provided in this article.
